item.title: Show HN: Xpt – minimalist C package manager
item.summary: I started XPT because I wanted a package manager that was simple enough to understand completely. Most package managers are bloated and hard to read. xpt is ~2000 lines of C What it does: - SQLite-backed package database - Dependency resolution with repo sync - ebt: POSIX shell toolkit for building packages It's functional but not yet polished or production-ready. Known issues are listed on the README in the repository. I'm looking for feedback from people enthusiastic about minimalist tools.
